messages:
Maya CS: Quick health check on Alpenglow — onboarding steady but tail latency spikes at p99 (~420ms) during peak. Recommend a staged optimization: 1) int8 quant for their Llama-variant, 2) add mixed routing (primary compact model + fallback full-precision for long contexts), 3) enable prefix KV caching for repeated prompts.
Liam SE: +1. Do we have perf diffs from their sample traffic? canary payload size?
Maya CS: Pulled a 1h sample from last night. Avg tokens/request ~210, 60% short prompts that benefit from compact model, 40% long (>=512). I ran a quick local int8 sim — ~28% token-cost savings, p99 median drop ~110–140ms in our env.
Noah CS: Thanks. Renewal flagged in 45 days; want to show cost win before renewal review. Can we schedule a 2-week canary with metrics dashboard?
Liam SE: I'll propose a minimal canary plan: route 10% of traffic to quantized model on dedicated pool, 5% fallback to fp16 when conf or seq>512, ramp to 30% if SLOs hold.
Liam SE: Example route config (suggested):
```json
{
  "routes": [
    {"name":"compact-primary","model":"llama-13b-int8","weight":0.10},
    {"name":"fp-fallback","model":"llama-13b-fp16","condition":"seq_len>512 || repeat_rate>0.6","weight":0.05}
  ],
  "cache": {"prefix_kv": true, "ttl_sec": 600}
}
```
Maya CS: Nice. Ops question — do we need a dedicated pool for the quant canary?
Liam SE: Prefer dedicated for isolation. Use 1 GPU pool with burst capacity. We can set autoscale min=1, max=3.
OpsBot: deploy-request created by Liam SE: /deploy canary alpenglow-int8 -> pool-dedicated-1. Link: https://console.redwood.ai/deploys/req/AX3Z
Noah CS: I'll book a 30-min sync with the Alpenglow eng lead tomorrow to walk through expected traffic patterns and set acceptance criteria.
Aria PM: We should capture a short before/after slide for renewal pack. Can we target a simple KPI: cost per 1k tokens and p99 latency?
Maya CS: Yes. KPI: token_cost_delta and p99_latency. Baseline: token_cost=0.48/1k, p99=420ms. Target after canary: token_cost <=0.36/1k, p99 <=330ms for routed traffic.
Liam SE: I'll add instrumentation hooks: per-route cost, tail latency, fallback rate, quality regression alert (BLEU/ROUGE-ish for their eval set).
Maya CS: Quick checklist:
- [ ] run canary for 72h at 10%
- [ ] monitor fallback rate <=5%
- [ ] quality regression <=0.5% on eval prompts
- [ ] prepare renewal slide w/ metrics
Noah CS: I'll drive scheduling and capture customer consent.
Liam SE: I'll start the deploy request and upload route json to the repo (link in thread once pushed).
Maya CS: Thanks team. tagging @Aria PM for renewal slide reminder. :thumbsup:
Aria PM: Got it — will prep a 1-slide summary and put it in the renewal folder.
Maya CS: If we see unexpectedly high fallbacks, revert routing to stable and escalate.
Liam SE: Agreed. Will add an automatic rollback policy if fallback_rate > 8% for 10m.
OpsBot: canary deployment status: queued -> running (pool-dedicated-1)
Liam SE: Pushing the config now. link: https://git.redwood.ai/alpenglow/canaries/patch-117
Maya CS: Great — will follow up after 24h snapshot with early numbers.
